description: This file defines a Spring Data MongoDB repository interface for managing Document entities, including custom query methods for filtering documents by user ID, category, title, and OCR text.

classes.name: DocumentRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Document entities, extending MongoRepository and providing custom finder methods.

methods.name: findByUserId
methods.description: Finds documents associated with a specific user ID.

methods.name: findByCategory
methods.description: Finds documents belonging to a specific category.

methods.name: findByTitleContainingIgnoreCase
methods.description: Finds documents with titles containing the specified text, case-insensitive.

methods.name: findByOcrTextContainingIgnoreCase
methods.description: Finds documents with OCR text containing the specified query, case-insensitive.
